target.statement: WID11 achieves 88.8 accuracy on SST-2 after task-agnostic distillation and fine-tuning

compute.basis: The paper reports 64 hours on 8 A100 GPUs for 400k distillation steps; even the 100k-step variant takes 16 hours on 8 A100s, far beyond a CPU-only laptop.

blockers: Requires 8 A100 GPUs for the reported 400k-step distillation; even reduced-step runs need multi-GPU
Pre-training corpus (Wikipedia + BookCorpus) is large and must be downloaded and preprocessed
No released distilled checkpoints for WID11; must re-run the full task-agnostic distillation
title: Weight-Inherited Distillation for Task-Agnostic BERT Compression
